scope: Architecture fit against docs/WORLD_RUNTIME_SPEC.md; offline tests and local probes only

worldseed.environment: Windows, Python 3.11.2, pytest 8.4.2, pytest-asyncio 1.4.0, source installed editable with base dependencies; UTF-8 explicitly enabled; no optional DM provider deps installed
worldseed.failureReason: All 25 test failures in these selections require missing configs/bunker.yaml or configs/minimal.yaml. Tests were not patched or supplied replacement fixtures.
worldseed.initialCollectionIssue: Without -X utf8, dm/prompt.py reads shared/languages.json using Windows GBK and raises UnicodeDecodeError

agentWorld.environment: Windows, Node.js 22.15.0, pnpm 9.15.0 frozen lockfile with install scripts disabled; manually built packages/core, packages/world and packages/memory
agentWorld.initialTestPrerequisite: Before core build, 146 tests passed and the two world suites could not resolve @agent-world/core exports. Building core resolved this.

limits: No real model API calls, no paid tokens, no browser UI or deployment verification for either upstream project
WorldSeed tests are selected subsets, not the full suite
AgentWorld vitest root suite discovers core/world tests only; passing it does not validate LLM adapters, WebSocket integration or exact replay
Probe scenarios intentionally expose architectural contracts; they are not claims that every bundled scenario corrupts state or reveals private messages
